resources.string:
Install KeyBORD first, then activate it with KeyBORD Activator. You can then use the keyboard in Jellyfin. If KeyBORD already works on your head unit, it will work here too.

Use the keyboard to enter at least your server address and username when signing in with a username.

Quick Connect works too! Enter your server address, then choose Quick Connect on the Jellyfin sign-in screen. Quick Connect is an alternative to entering your username and password.

BlueLink modem data is blocked. Connect the head unit to Wi-Fi, such as your phone\'s hotspot. Android Auto internet sharing is not yet verified for this app.\nKeyboard required for typing; see KeyBORD setup above. Quick Connect works!
